question: According to the passage, what will shape India’s digital future?
solution:
The correct answer is '**Option 4**'.

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• ***Inclusive access & safe innovation***

 
 
• The passage concludes that India stands at a crucial intersection where robust digital policy, inclusive access, and responsible innovation will determine the trajectory of its digital future.
 
 
 
• ***Other Options***
 
 
• Launching more apps, increasing digital taxes, and stricter online control are not mentioned in the passage as factors that will shape India’s digital future.
 
 

Therefore, the correct answer is **Option 4: Inclusive access & safe innovation**.

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Option 1: Launching more apps** – Not mentioned in the passage as a decisive factor.
 
• **Option 2: Increasing digital taxes** – Not discussed in the passage.
 
• **Option 3: Stricter online control** – Not highlighted as a factor in the passage.
 
• **Option 4: Inclusive access & safe innovation** – Explicitly mentioned as shaping India’s digital future.
